purpose: Define independent fresh-review batches, required source-resolution checks and promotion boundaries for the 24 locally reviewed C2-LT-B3 source-context extraction rows without storing verdicts inside the protocol artifact.

scope.selectionRule: Every C2-LT-B3 local-review row must receive independent fresh review before any reviewed artifact or model-admission claim; rows flagged in the source-resolution register must also review the corrected, split or route-normalized candidates before artifact fill.
nonClaims: This protocol is not an independent fresh review verdict register.
This protocol does not complete Source Cards, variable cards, endpoint cards, uncertainty cards, transfer-boundary cards or downgrade-check artifacts.
This protocol does not repair the source extraction register or replace corrected-source re-extraction.
This protocol does not authorize calibrated prediction, individual advice, individual death-date output, intervention ranking, domain-claim upgrade or clinical-validity claims.

sourceResolutionRules: Rows listed in sourceResolutionIssueTaskIds cannot fill reviewed artifacts from the original mismatched or access-blocked source row.
source-resolution-supported may proceed only to corrected source re-extraction or bounded companion-source review, not direct model admission.
Corrected, split or route-normalized candidates must preserve source identity, currentness, exact claim, endpoint, uncertainty, transfer boundary, downgrade trigger and model-position checks.

Publisher access-blocked rows may use companion bibliographic records only as bounded source-context support until the primary route is manually accessible or a current authoritative equivalent is verified.
promotionRules: support-with-boundary or bounded-support may proceed only to bounded reviewed-artifact fill for rows without unresolved source-resolution issues, never directly to model admission.
source-resolution-supported rows may proceed only to eligible-for-corrected-source-reextraction or bounded companion-source review before any artifact fill.
downgrade-required rows must carry a downgrade note before artifact fill and remain blocked for calibrated prediction.
reject-source-context-mismatch rows must not fill reviewed artifacts until source identity or role is corrected.
cannot-evaluate-insufficient-context rows remain blocked until a primary or authoritative source can be independently checked.
Artifact promotion decisions are limited to eligible-for-bounded-artifact-fill, eligible-for-corrected-source-reextraction, downgrade-before-fill, rejected-no-fill and blocked-cannot-evaluate.
